tools.name: forecast_race
tools.description: Current VotePredictor forecast for one 2026 US election: win probability, predicted margin, whether it comes from polls or fundamentals, how far it has moved this cycle, and the candidates. Accepts a state name or code ('Ohio', 'OH') or a district ('CA-12'). Returns an explicit refusal for races whe

tools.name: chamber_outlook
tools.description: Who is favoured to control the Senate or House after 2026: control probability, expected seats with an 80% range, how far it has moved since January, and the races that have moved most since the current model began (its latest revision).

tools.name: forecaster_accuracy
tools.description: How accurate each election forecaster, model, prediction market and pollster has been on resolved races, adjusted for how hard each race was. Use this to answer 'whose election forecast should I trust'. Difficulty adjustment matters: on raw scores whoever rated the safest races wins.

tools.name: member_profile
tools.description: A member of Congress by name or bioguide id: party, state, ideology score, reported net worth from financial disclosures, and the 2026 race for their seat.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "chamber_outlook" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Who is favoured to control the Senate or House after 2026: control probability, expected seats with an 80% range, how far it has moved since January, and the races that have moved most." → after: "Who is favoured to control the Senate or House after 2026: control probability, expected seats with an 80% range, how far it has moved since January, and the races that have moved most since the current model began (its latest revision)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
